points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake locates MPI, CGNS/HDF5 and METIS; README documents the build, but no independent clean build was run.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main/config source implements the required solve --case/--output interface and FatalError paths.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Distinct mesh, partition, halo, flux, reconstruction, residual, driver and output modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal wrapper/executable evidence found. Trust policy bars external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case configuration and CGNS input control the solver; no two-filename-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS, neighbour point-to-point exchange and reductions are source-evidenced, but cylinder steady Cd is 5.706 at np1/2/4 versus 1.953 at production np8: order-one inconsistency.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Mesh/config checks, positivity backtracking and finite diagnostics are present; no independent stress run.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: All eight output packages pass the official validator and rank artifacts exist, but the cylinder rank evidence fails consistency.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable C++17 sources and curated submission; report source depends on excluded raw result/manifests for full regeneration.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
